column3: Resets the HUD offsets, clip bounds, popups, indicator timers, and animation counters.
Sets the HUD projection and draws status meters, compass, spell UI, actor icons, and popups according to game state.
Draws two model-stat ratios as animated bars with numeric current and maximum values.
Draws four player values and pulsing status symbols beside the meters.
Draws the rotating compass graphic and, when a target is available, a relative-direction marker.
Draws four input choices and the current three-element sequence, including transition effects.
Looks up the encoded name from the actor's spell ID and draws it in a centered panel.
Draws four spirit values and consumes directional input to increase one capped value and set milestone flags.
Projects the selected D_8007ABF0 world object to screen and draws a bobbing sprite above it.
Projects an indexed enemy to screen and draws a bobbing marker above its model-dependent height.
Projects the player's upper position and draws a palette-textured icon above it.
Records a status-icon index and optionally creates a visual effect attached to the actor.
Draws active actor status icons and updates or expires their attached visual effects.
Clears all status-icon slots and ends any attached visual effects.
Draws a timed panel with a name pointer and numeric values from D_8007C028.
Clears every entry in the eight-slot popup pool.
Allocates a 45-frame popup attached to an actor and sets its sprite and height.
Projects each timed popup's world position and draws its sprite.
Looks up a spell from input bytes, computes restriction flags, and draws its label with a matching palette.
Consumes encoded glyph bytes and emits textured rectangles with control-byte spacing.
Sums glyph widths and control-byte spacing until the encoded string terminator.
Formats an integer into digits and draws each digit from the HUD texture.
Loads either an 8-bit or 4-bit color-indexed texture tile from a texture descriptor.
Offsets and clips the rectangle to HUD bounds, then emits a texture-rectangle command.
Loads a texture tile and draws it at the requested rectangle.
